import json, glob, re
files = sorted(glob.glob('event-*.json'))
hits=[]
for f in files:
    j=json.load(open(f))
    if j.get('kind')!='MessageEvent': continue
    role=j.get('llm_message',{}).get('role')
    if role!='user': continue
    c=j['llm_message'].get('content')
    t=c[0].get('text') if isinstance(c,list) and c and isinstance(c[0],dict) else str(c)
    if re.search(r'cloude?flare|cloudflare|vps|solve|solver|captcha', t, re.I):
        hits.append((j['timestamp'],t))
for ts,t in hits: print('===',ts); print(t[:800]); print()
EOF
